settings.title: Settings
settings.tooShort: New password must be at least 4 characters
settings.restartHint: Saving restarts both core-api and worker to apply the new config. Your current session will also be invalidated and you'll need to log in again.
settings.saveRestarting: Saved. Services are restarting, redirecting to login…
settings.maxSessionsHint: Maximum chat sessions kept per user; once exceeded, the oldest session (by last update time) is automatically deleted.
settings.maxKeywordsHint: Upper bound on the content-keyword cloud shown on a book's detail page. Changing this applies immediately to already-summarized books — no re-summarizing needed.
settings.skipBackmatterChapters: Skip bibliography/index chapters when generating chapter summaries
settings.debugLoggingHint: When on, every LLM call's request and response are each saved as a file under the mynexus-llm-debug subdirectory of the OS temp dir — replay one with worker/tests/replay_llm_debug.py.
settings.embeddingChangedHint: Embedding provider or model changed — rebuild each book's index after saving for it to take effect.
settings.retrievalFusionHint: Weighted sum blends raw scores directly and is sensitive to score scales; RRF fuses by rank and is more robust to score distributions.
settings.retrievalWeightsHint: Each weight only joins normalisation when its retrieval returned results; they don't need to sum to 1.
settings.localModelHint: The model loads on first vectorization (~90–220MB) — no API key needed; data never leaves this machine.
settings.localModelPathPlaceholder: Leave empty to download and cache from HuggingFace automatically
settings.localModelPathHint: When set, the model loads from this directory first (it still downloads there if missing). Docker deployments default to /data/models; change the mount in docker-compose.yml.
settings.chapterTokenBudgetHint: Only applies to OpenAI-compatible providers: when a chapter's estimated tokens exceed this limit, the text is head/tail-sampled down to it before being sent to the LLM, to control whole-book summarization token usage (5000–50000, 0 for no limit).
settings.localNoTest: Local mode needs no connectivity test — just index books after saving.
settings.mybooksBaseUrlHint: e.g. http://your.mybooks:8081 (port must not clash with MyNexus core-api 8080)
